children: Atara Biotherapeutics’ revenue declined from the year-earlier quarter, while its net loss narrowed. Revenue was lower because the prior-year period included a one-time acceleration of revenue after the transfer of tab-cel manufacturing responsibilities to Pierre Fabre; current-quarter revenue came from ongoing regulatory activities and clinical vial sales. Lower operating expenses also contributed to the narrower loss.
¹ Reported as “Commercialization revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted (loss) earnings per common share”.
: Pierre Fabre resubmitted the BLA in September; the FDA accepted it in October for Class 2 review with a March 31, 2027 target action date.
: R&D expenses fell to $1.1M from $2.9M, primarily reflecting transferred activities and reduced headcount.
: The board continued to evaluate potential strategic transactions.
